name: Explosive Weapon (Mythic)
body:
Magic channeled through your weapon becomes truly devastating.

Prerequisite(s): Explosive Weapon.

Benefit(s): You can release a non-instantaneous area spell through your weapon as part of a melee or ranged attack.

You can choose to center the spell effect on the target of your melee attack rather than on yourself.
